comments.body:
Ngl I just recently got an iPad 9th gen, and am doing a math and computer science degree at University (not ETH). Just a cautious redditor here.

I think I might be the perfect person to answer your question.  I think it is very worth it to get an iPad for notes. Genuinely exponentially makes life easier. A few main points.

1. Having two large devices on the go for lecture watching is just blazingly efficient for multitasking. 

2. No paper trail -> Amazing.

3. Very good specifically in the domain of math proofs, being able to easily annotate the answers, add your thinking process as a form of notes, and modify answers easily is very convenient.

However I will say don't just use an iPad to write linear notes.  Don't just dump a bunch of information on goodnotes, that you will either never revisit or just concise anyways. Id look into non-linear note taking and getting good at what works for you. Paper is at least a couple hundred [any currency] cheaper.

Overall a great buy. Send it.

Cheers.
comments.author: Money-Panda9038
